create_Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration_m: create a Qwen3.5-27B model from pretrained weights using transformers AutoProcessor
configure_QuantizationModifier_NVFP4: configure NVFP4 weight quantization with per-group 16 scheme skipping lm_head and visual layers
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a model with a QuantizationModifier recipe for fp4 weights
run_dispatch_model_offload: run dispatch_model to offload a quantized model for generation
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format with MTP tensors
